verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes a structured Sandbox API reference covering commands, files, interpreter, ports and sessions. It is rich in copy-pasteable code examples (writeFile/readFile, mkdir, watch, createSession, a pandas interpreter snippet) that a user can run in their own Worker. A site-wide openapi.json and llms.txt also exist. However, nothing shows an interactive reference with in-page, runnable examples: the examples are static and must be deployed to run, and the OpenAPI file is not shown to cover the Sandbox SDK. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it or playground API explorer, examples runnable directly from the docs, and Sandbox-specific machine-readable or OpenAPI coverage.
